items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Old Budd Johnson was back there, had his saxophone

ctx.x: like that. It wouldn't tear the house down. We just did a couple of numbers, maybe a little short number or (?). And we were out in the middle of the stage, then back of us was a big band, a cabaret band it was supposed to be, and all the people sitting around in a nightclub. They had more musicians sitting up in that band that weren't musicians, but they looked the part -- they looked good. Old Budd Johnson was back there, had his saxophone, and... They had some nice-looking girls in that picture. I know that.…
But you had to look quick, though, to catch us in the picture, because it was such a short... You know, just two short numbers. That was about it.
